answer: A lagoon admits newcomers only by public referral: each locks 70 credits and earns its edge on one voyage with its referrer, logged on the lagoon graph, crystal-clear. Any peer may dispute a crystal-graph edge for 20; a star cluster or rented referrer fails, the fake's escrow burns, half to the challenger. Edge k under one referrer costs 15+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,512,500, lock 70,000; an honest agent pays 15 once, deposit back post-voyage.
